hypotheses: After each edit iaso tells the agent which links it made stale, and the end-of-turn hook holds the turn while a link this turn made stale is unresolved, at most hooks.stale_holds_max times (3 by default); after that the turn ends and the unresolved link becomes one question through the question tool; iaso files it as a question for the agent to ask, which iaso withdraws by itself once the link is current again, and nothing is shown to the owner to press. A check that waits on an unreachable judge never holds the turn. The link is repinned when covering tests pass and the judge says the meaning is kept, a record that disagrees with its intent is reworded, an unrequested intent-breaking change goes back to the agent, and the owner is asked through the question tool only when confirmed intent would change. Workflow agents get the same. In main's checkout the turn is not held for a stale link: no work happens there, and it is resolved on a branch (SR-384).
given the agent edits a function that SR-005's implemented_by link pins, when the edit hook runs, then the agent is told in one line that SR-005's link to that file is stale
given an intent is reworded and SR-032 derives from it, when the rewording is recorded, then the agent is told SR-032 may no longer agree with that intent

given a link this turn made stale and not yet resolved, and no regression, covering-test run or untraced file of the turn comes first (SR-373's one next action), when the agent tries to end its turn, then the end-of-turn hook keeps the turn open and names the link
given a link that was already stale before the turn began, when the turn's first edit is checked, then it is listed to the agent once and does not keep the turn open

given src/iaso/commands.py is refactored under confirmed SR-003 and SR-003's covering tests pass, when the agent resolves the stale link, then the judge (JEV above its calibrated threshold, else the configured judge model) is shown SR-003's statement and examples next to the diff, says the meaning is kept, and the link is repinned and logged with its one-sentence reason; the owner is not asked
given an edit only reformatted a file and its linked tests pass, when the agent resolves the link, then it is repinned without involving the owner

given a change removes the tests checking a confirmed example of SR-005 with no replacement, when the agent resolves those links, then each repin is refused with the judge's reason naming the examples no longer checked, and the link stays stale until the record is reworded or the owner answers, through the question tool, whether the requirement should change

given an edit changes what a requirement the owner confirmed says the system does, and the owner asked for that change, when the agent resolves the link, then the change is filed as one question for the owner, asked through the question tool; the link is not repinned

given the judge cannot be reached, when the agent resolves a stale link, then nothing is repinned, the link stays stale and iaso says once that judging is unavailable; no verdict is decided by rule, and the turn is not held for the check that waits on the judge
given the judge answers that the diff is too large to judge, when the agent resolves the link, then nothing is repinned and the refusal says why

given a link this turn made stale is still unresolved after the end-of-turn hook held the turn hooks.stale_holds_max times (3 by default), the last hold saying 'Held 3 of 3', when the agent tries to end its turn again, then the turn ends, the link stays stale, the agent is told the hold ended, and the link is filed as one open stale-link question for the owner

given the judge says the meaning changed in wording only, when the stale link is resolved, then the record is reworded, the rewording passes the judge and is recorded as judge-approved, and the link is repinned; the owner is not asked

given INT-029 and SR-038 agree, and a turn about cold-start timing edits the contradiction check so a contradicting prompt is no longer flagged, when the stale link is resolved, then the change goes back to the agent as development work naming SR-038's broken example, and the owner is not asked

given SR-081 still says the heuristic judges compatibility while INT-029 says there is no heuristic, when its stale link is resolved, then the requirement is reworded to agree with INT-029, not sent back to development
given it is unclear whether the change was wanted, when the stale link is resolved, then the owner is asked through the question tool; nothing is sent back to development on a guess

given a change to a shared file leaves what the requirement relies on as it was, and the tests pass, when the stale link is resolved, then the link is repinned and neither the owner nor the agent is asked
given a workflow agent changes code a requirement links to, when its work ends, then the stale link is reported to it to resolve, as it is to the main session

given a link pinned to a file version that was never committed, when the work is committed, then the pinned version stays readable, so the link shows stale after the commit, is held like any other new stale link, and a repin can judge the change from the pinned text
given the agent wants to know what would be repinned, when it asks iaso for a repin dry run, then the judge's verdicts are listed with their reasons; no test runs and no pin changes

given the agent asks for a repin dry run, of one link, of a record or of every stale link, with or without the check of the covering tests, when the dry run finishes, then it lists the links it would repin; no record file changes and no log entry is written
